guarantees: validates command input before any platform or runner execution
does not touch WeChat windows, files, clipboard, or DB state

moments-marketing: targets[] or browseLimit for feed browsing

writeLikeCommands: matched readback on output.readback or output.results[].readback
chatHistory: output.sessions[] or output.messages[] must be non-empty

statusSchema.success: 命令完成且有可信输出。
statusSchema.partial: 命令部分完成，调用方必须检查 output 和 diagnostics。
statusSchema.blocked: 命令被能力、平台、权限、风控或实现状态阻断；不得当作成功。
statusSchema.failed: 命令执行失败，调用方应读取 errorCode/errorDetail/diagnostics。

responseShape.ok: boolean; false means blocked/failed/skipped and must not be treated as success
responseShape.errorCode: success or a stable machine-readable failure code
responseShape.output: command-specific output; blocked commands return empty/blocked output only

commandMatrix.notes: Reads contacts through plaintext DB, self-developed helper contract, or Windows UIAutomation fallback.

commandMatrix.supportsAutoSend: only when a self-developed external runner returns readback evidence
commandMatrix.notes: Invokes a configured self-developed runner first; otherwise validates targets/content/rate limit and blocks without sending.

commandMatrix.notes: Invokes a configured self-developed runner first; otherwise validates targets, verify message, blacklist tags, remark policy and blocks.

commandMatrix.notes: Invokes a configured self-developed runner first; otherwise validates copy/media paths and blocks before publish.

commandMatrix.notes: Invokes a configured self-developed runner first; otherwise validates mode/actions/comment material and blocks.
Invokes a configured self-developed reader first; otherwise returns a stable blocked read contract and never fabricates sessions or messages.

commercialLimitations: No command in this runtime performs real bulk sending, contact adding, Moments publishing, liking, commenting, or chat extraction beyond the implemented contacts collector.
Write-like WeChat tasks may call a configured self-developed external runner, but success is rejected unless real action/readback evidence is returned.
Without a configured runner, write-like WeChat tasks move through an audited controlled-preflight runner and stay blocked.
Do not copy or embed third-party WeChat automation/decryption code.

successRequirements: write-like commands must return raw.realWechatActionAttempted:true or diagnostics.raw.realWechatActionAttempted:true
write-like commands must return readback.matched:true on top-level output or at least one result
write-like commands must return evidence[] or screenshotPath on output/results/diagnostics
chat-history must return a real source plus non-empty sessions[] or messages[]
chat-history must return evidence[] or screenshotPath on output/diagnostics

successShape.contacts: string[] display names derived from items
successShape.items: Array<{ wxid, nickname, remark, alias, tags, source }>

failureShape.diagnostics: includes platform/window/db/helper/uia layer status and failureLayer

modeSemantics.random: database/helper sync only up to 500; UIA/OCR screen collection is disabled by default
modeSemantics.all: database/helper full sync only up to 50000; UIA/OCR screen collection is disabled by default

stdin.process: { processId, processName, executablePath, mainWindowHandle, windowTitle, wechatVersion }

stdout.items: Array<{ wxid, nickname, remark, alias, tags }>

nextAction: 合同摘要已输出，可按 commandMatrix 对接调用方。
